Rules.InvariantScript:
Set(varOpenTicket, Blank());
Set(varBlink, false);
ClearCollect(
    colAllTickets,
    ForAll(
        AdministrativeServiceRequests,
        {
            Key: "ADM-" & ID,
            Src: "Administrative",
            RecId: ID,
            Ticket: Coalesce(ServiceSubcategory, Title),
            Desc: Description,
            Category: Title,
            StatusText: Status.Value,
            Requester: RequestedBy,
            CreatedOn: Created,
            Cur: With(
                {st: Lower(Trim(Coalesce(Status.Value, "submitted")))},
                If(
                    st in ["completed", "complete", "closed", "resolved", "done", "fulfilled"], 5,
                    st in ["approved", "in progress", "assigned", "working", "scheduled"], 3,
                    2
                )
            )
        }
    ),
    ForAll(
        'Locksmith Requests',
        {
            Key: "LCK-" & ID,
            Src: "Locksmith",
            RecId: ID,
            Ticket: Title,
            Desc: Description,
            Category: RequestType,
            StatusText: RequestStatus,
            Requester: RequesterName,
            CreatedOn: Created,
            Cur: With(
                {st: Lower(Trim(Coalesce(RequestStatus, "submitted")))},
                If(
                    st in ["completed", "complete", "closed", "resolved", "done", "fulfilled"], 5,
                    st in ["approved", "in progress", "assigned", "working", "scheduled"], 3,
                    2
                )
            )
        }
    )
)
varOpenTicket.Src & "-" & varOpenTicket.RecId & "  •  " & If(varOpenTicket.Cur >= 5, "All steps complete", "Step " & varOpenTicket.Cur & " of 4")
Switch(ThisItem.St, "complete", RGBA(16, 124, 16, 1), "done", RGBA(0, 120, 212, 1), "current", If(varBlink, RGBA(0, 120, 212, 1), RGBA(199, 224, 244, 1)), RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1))
If(Coalesce(varOpenTicket.Key, "") = ThisItem.Key, Set(varOpenTicket, Blank()), Set(varOpenTicket, ThisItem))

If(
    !IsBlank(varOpenTicket.ID) &&
    varOpenTicket.ID = ThisItem.ID &&
    varOpenTicket.TicketSource = ThisItem.TicketSource,
    RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1)
)
With({c: ThisItem.Cur}, If(c >= 5 || 1 < c || (1 = c && varBlink), RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1), RGBA(0, 40, 85, 1)))
With({c: ThisItem.Cur}, If(c >= 5 || 2 < c || (2 = c && varBlink), RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1), RGBA(0, 40, 85, 1)))
With({c: ThisItem.Cur}, If(c >= 5 || 3 < c || (3 = c && varBlink), RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1), RGBA(0, 40, 85, 1)))
With({c: ThisItem.Cur}, If(c >= 5 || 4 < c || (4 = c && varBlink), RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1), RGBA(0, 40, 85, 1)))
